questions.question: The apostle Peter told believers to rejoice in their fiery trial. What reason did he give?

answers.text: Their trial proves their own strength
Their enemies will soon give up

questions.question: The apostle Peter said believers insulted for the name of Christ are blessed. Why are they blessed?

answers.text: The Spirit of glory rests on them
The angels of heaven guard them
Their insulters will be struck down

questions.question: The apostle Peter said that if a believer suffers as a Christian, what should the believer not be?
The apostle Peter said those who suffer according to God's will should do what with their souls?

answers.text: Entrust them to their faithful Creator
